sequence.py: Chǎo yóu yú, běnlái shì yí dào cài.
sequence.en: 炒鱿鱼 was originally a dish.

sequence.cn: 鱿鱼一下锅就卷起来的样子，很像铺盖卷起来的形状。
sequence.py: Yóu yú yí xià guō jiù juǎn qǐlái de yàngzi, hěn xiàng pūgai juǎn qǐlái de xíngzhuàng.
sequence.en: The way squid curls up the moment it hits the pan looks a lot like the shape of rolled-up bedding.

sequence.cn: 而铺盖一卷，人就要走了——所以被炒鱿鱼，就成了被开除的意思。
sequence.py: Ér pūgai yì juǎn, rén jiù yào zǒu le — suǒyǐ bèi chǎo yóu yú, jiù chéng le bèi kāichú de yìsi.
sequence.en: And once the bedding gets rolled up, that person is about to leave — so getting 炒鱿鱼 came to mean getting fired.

sequence.cn: 我表姐最近工作出了点小事，连续迟到了三个星期。
sequence.py: Wǒ biǎojiě zuìjìn gōngzuò chū le diǎn xiǎo shì, liánxù chídào le sān ge xīngqī.
sequence.en: My cousin has been having some trouble at work — three weeks late in a row.

sequence.cn: 那天早上老板一个电话，把她叫进了办公室。
sequence.py: Nà tiān zǎoshang lǎobǎn yí ge diànhuà, bǎ tā jiào jìn le bàngōngshì.
sequence.en: That morning the boss called and got her into his office.

sequence.cn: 她推门之前心想：这下完了，怎么跟妈妈说被炒鱿鱼。
sequence.py: Tā tuī mén zhīqián xīnxiǎng: zhè xià wán le, zěnme gēn māma shuō bèi chǎo yóu yú.
sequence.en: Before pushing the door, she thought: I'm done — how do I tell Mom I got fired?

sequence.cn: 她走进办公室，看见老板笑着从抽屉里拿出一个红包。
sequence.py: Tā zǒu jìn bàngōngshì, kànjiàn lǎobǎn xiàozhe cóng chōuti lǐ ná chū yí ge hóngbāo.
sequence.en: She walked in and saw the boss smiling, pulling a red envelope out of a drawer.

sequence.cn: 原来今天不是被炒，是提前发年终奖。
sequence.py: Yuánlái jīntiān bú shì bèi chǎo, shì tíqián fā niánzhōng jiǎng.
sequence.en: Turns out today wasn't a firing — it was the year-end bonus, handed out early.

sequence.cn: 她一下子松了口气，说：那我下周开始，一定不迟到。
sequence.py: Tā yíxiàzi sōng le kǒu qì, shuō: nà wǒ xià zhōu kāishǐ, yídìng bù chídào.
sequence.en: She let out a huge breath and said: alright, from next week I promise I won't be late.
